From: intake-referral@synthetic-referral.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 1, 2026
Subject: Agency charge and right-to-sue packet for review

The attached synthetic agency charge and right-to-sue letter concern Elena Park and Meridian Market LLC. The referral note identifies a discrimination and retaliation claim, a federal forum, and removal posture still under review. The employee handbook is not yet provided. The agency filing date, right-to-sue receipt date, and complaint deadline are labeled as deadline candidates for human review.

Synthetic agency record summary: Elena Park filed an agency charge against Meridian Market LLC on May 4, 2026. A right-to-sue letter was received on June 20, 2026. The charge alleges discrimination, retaliation, and termination after protected activity. The forum is expected to be federal court, but removal posture and arbitration posture require review. This synthetic record supports intake budget testing only.
